note: Changes that are finished but are waiting for the next card update, because sending one costs a signed update to every card in a customer's home. Run "npm run firmware:waiting" to read this, and "npm run firmware:release" to carry it all at once.

waiting.what: Stop a rename inside a settings file from demanding a card update on its own.
waiting.why: The change teaches the build system to tell a harmless rename apart from a real change to what the cards do. It cannot land by itself, because changing that judgement is treated as the most suspicious kind of change there is — which is correct, and is exactly the trap it exists to remove.

waiting.what: Turn on six more automatic checks that run before anything ships.
waiting.why: Switching them on means editing one settings file, and editing that file is treated as a change to what the cards do — so six extra checks would otherwise cost a signed update to every card in a customer's home for an unchanged card.
